title: The prescribed cochain pullback tensor comparison commutes with both signed shifts
statement: For a ringed pullback f and its prescribed tensor comparison k on independently sized sites, package the inverse-contraction cochain comparisons as a natural transformation of curried total tensor functors. For every fixed first input its component commutes with the canonical integer shifts in the second input; for every fixed second input its flipped component commutes with the shifts in the first input. The second-input shift includes the Koszul sign and the first-input shift is unsigned.

proof.text: Package k.mu as a natural transformation of module bifunctors. Its naturality follows by specializing k.naturality to an identity in either input. Package the prescribed cochain comparison using the proved cochainComparison_monoidal naturality equation.

The ordinary pullback is a left adjoint, hence preserves the coproducts defining totalization. Test equality with the general additive mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans on every coproduct summand. Compose with the prescribed comparison inverse. The inverse is the contraction map: its summand formula cancels k.mu with its inverse, leaving the same image of the inclusion map. Coproduct extensionality proves equality of the two chain comparisons.

Apply the proved source-library instances HomologicalComplex.commShift_mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans_app and commShift_mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans_flipApp to that module transformation. These instances use precisely the canonical unsigned first-input and signed second-input total shifts. Rewrite by the summand identification. This proves compatibility for the prescribed cochain map, including every negative shift.
